# 2025 archive

# Learning with Agents

> NYU Agentic AI workshop materials taught by Adi Singhal and Luca Chang.

- [2026 workshop](https://learningwithagents.com/2026/): Current edition with curriculum, recordings, chapters, slides and starter code.
- [2026 Markdown](https://learningwithagents.com/2026.md): The same published course in text.
- [2025 archive](https://learningwithagents.com/2025/): Historical course and recordings.
- [2025 Markdown](https://learningwithagents.com/2025.md): The same archive in text.
- [Workshop data](https://learningwithagents.com/api/v1/workshops.json): Structured information for both years.
- [API specification](https://learningwithagents.com/openapi.json): Available read-only GET endpoints.
- [Agent guidance](https://learningwithagents.com/agents.md): Reading and citation instructions.
- [Access](https://learningwithagents.com/auth.md): Public access and failure handling.
- [Privacy](https://adityasinghal.com/privacy/): Shared privacy information.
